name: commercetools Commerce MCP
description: Enables AI agents to interact with commercetools APIs to manage products, categories, orders, carts, and customer data. It provides a comprehensive set of tools for both read-only and full-access operations through secure authentication methods.

rawRecord.description: Enables AI agents to interact with commercetools APIs to manage products, categories, orders, carts, and customer data. It provides a comprehensive set of tools for both read-only and full-access operations through secure authentication methods.

port.description: Port to listen on when using remote/streamable mode.

tools.description: Tools to enable. Options: 'all', 'all.read', or specific tools like 'products.read,products.create'.

clientId.description: The commercetools client ID. Required for 'client_credentials' authentication.

accessToken.description: A pre-existing access token for authentication. Required if authType is 'auth_token'.

clientSecret.description: The commercetools client secret. Required for 'client_credentials' authentication.

dynamicToolLoadingThreshold.description: The threshold of enabled tools to switch to dynamic tool loading (defaults to 30).

DYNAMIC_TOOL_LOADING_THRESHOLD.description: Environment variable to set the dynamic tool loading threshold (defaults to 30).
